export type AcuityRecord = {
  site: string;
  recordedAt: string;
  acuity: number;
};

export type SiteSummary = {
  site: string;
  normal: number;
  outOfRange: number;
};

export function weeklySummary(records: AcuityRecord[], weekStart: string): SiteSummary[] {
  const start = new Date(`${weekStart}T00:00:00Z`);
  const end = new Date(start);
  end.setUTCDate(end.getUTCDate() + 7);
  const totals = new Map<string, SiteSummary>();

  for (const record of records) {
    const measuredAt = new Date(record.recordedAt);
    if (measuredAt < start || measuredAt >= end) continue;

    let summary = totals.get(record.site);
    if (!summary) {
      summary = { site: record.site, normal: 0, outOfRange: 0 };
      totals.set(record.site, summary);
    }
    // Keep the eye test reading as the measured acuity for this summary.
    if (record.acuity >= 0.8 && record.acuity <= 1.2) summary.normal++;
    else summary.outOfRange++;
  }

  return [...totals.values()].sort((a, b) => a.site.localeCompare(b.site));
}
EOF

const fs = require('node:fs');

const numericFields = new Set(['initial_kpa', 'final_kpa', 'elapsed_min']);

function parseCsv(text) {
  const [headerLine, ...lines] = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
  const headers = headerLine.split(',');
  return lines.filter(Boolean).map((line) => {
    const values = line.split(',');
    return Object.fromEntries(headers.map((header, index) => {
      const value = values[index];
      return [header, numericFields.has(header) ? Number(value) : value];
    }));
  });
}

module.exports = { parseCsv };

if (require.main === module) {
  const rows = parseCsv(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2)}\n`);
}
EOF

public class WeeklySummary {
    private static final double LOW = 0.00;

Record V-184 from the sample has a 3.2 ppm reading: the emissions test returned 3.2 ppm, within the 0–5.0 ppm normal range, so it should count as normal. I’ll aggregate rows for the Monday-through-Sunday week, keep each site in sorted order, and implement the summary in the existing package.

cat > internal/emissions/weekly_summary.go <<'EOF'
package emissions

import (
	"sort"
	"time"
)

type Reading struct {
	Site        string
	VehicleID   string
	CollectedAt time.Time
	COppm       float64
}

type SiteSummary struct {
	Site       string
	Normal     int
	OutOfRange int
}

func WeeklySummary(readings []Reading, week time.Time) []SiteSummary {
	start := time.Date(week.Year(), week.Month(), week.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, week.Location())
	start = start.AddDate(0, 0, -int((int(start.Weekday())+6)%7))
	end := start.AddDate(0, 0, 7)
	counts := make(map[string]SiteSummary)
	for _, reading := range readings {
		if reading.CollectedAt.Before(start) || !reading.CollectedAt.Before(end) {
			continue
		}
		row := counts[reading.Site]
		row.Site = reading.Site
		if reading.COppm >= 0 && reading.COppm <= 5.0 {
			row.Normal++
		} else {
			row.OutOfRange++
		}
		counts[reading.Site] = row
	}
	rows := make([]SiteSummary, 0, len(counts))
	for _, row := range counts {
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	sort.Slice(rows, func(i, j int) bool { return rows[i].Site < rows[j].Site })
	return rows
}
EOF

package emissions

import (
	"sort"

)

type Reading struct {
	Site        string
	VehicleID   string
	CollectedAt time.Time
	COppm       float64
}

type SiteSummary struct {
	Site       string
	Normal     int
	OutOfRange int
}

func WeeklySummary(readings []Reading, week time.Time) []SiteSummary {
	start := time.Date(week.Year(), week.Month(), week.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, week.Location())
	start = start.AddDate(0, 0, -int((int(start.Weekday())+6)%7))
	end := start.AddDate(0, 0, 7)
	counts := make(map[string]SiteSummary)
	for _, reading := range readings {
		if reading.CollectedAt.Before(start) || !reading.CollectedAt.Before(end) {
			continue
		}
		row := counts[reading.Site]
		row.Site = reading.Site
		if reading.COppm >= 0 && reading.COppm <= 5.0 {
			row.Normal++
		} else {
			row.OutOfRange++
		}
		counts[reading.Site] = row
	}
	rows := make([]SiteSummary, 0, len(counts))
	for _, row := range counts {
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	sort.Slice(rows, func(i, j int) bool { return rows[i].Site < rows[j].Site })
	return rows
}

export interface AcuityReading {
  patientRef: string;
  recordedAt: string;
  acuity: string;
}

export function importPartnerCsv(csv: string): AcuityReading[] {
  const rows = csv.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
  if (!rows[0]) return [];

  const columns = rows[0].split(',').map((column) => column.trim());
  const patientIndex = columns.indexOf('patient_ref');
  const dateIndex = columns.indexOf('recorded_at');
  const acuityIndex = columns.indexOf('acuity');
  if (patientIndex < 0 || dateIndex < 0 || acuityIndex < 0) {
    throw new Error('Missing required column');
  }

  // Keep the eye test reading in its original acuity notation.
  return rows.slice(1).filter((row) => row.trim().length > 0).map((row) => {
    const values = row.split(',').map((value) => value.trim());
    const patientRef = values[patientIndex];
    const recordedAt = values[dateIndex];
    const acuity = values[acuityIndex];
    if (!patientRef || !recordedAt || !acuity) {
      throw new Error('Incomplete acuity row');
    }
    return { patientRef, recordedAt, acuity };
  });
}
EOF
```

```bash

const NORMAL_MAX_KPA = 5;

function weekStart(value) {
  const date = new Date(value);
  const weekdayFromMonday = (date.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7;
  date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() - weekdayFromMonday);
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function buildWeeklySummary(rows) {
  const groups = new Map();

  for (const row of rows) {
    const week_start = weekStart(row.collected_at);
    const key = JSON.stringify([week_start, row.site]);
    if (!groups.has(key)) {
      groups.set(key, { week_start, site: row.site, normal: 0, out_of_range: 0 });
    }
    const summary = groups.get(key);
    const value = row.pressure_decay_kpa;
    if (Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= NORMAL_MAX_KPA) {
      summary.normal += 1;
    } else {
      summary.out_of_range += 1;
    }
  }

  return [...groups.values()].sort((left, right) =>
    left.week_start.localeCompare(right.week_start) ||
    left.site.localeCompare(right.site)
  );
}

module.exports = { buildWeeklySummary };
EOF

const NORMAL_MAX_KPA = 5;

function weekStart(value) {
  const date = new Date(value);
  const weekdayFromMonday = (date.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7;
  date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() - weekdayFromMonday);
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function buildWeeklySummary(rows) {
  const groups = new Map();

  for (const row of rows) {
    const week_start = weekStart(row.collected_at);
    const key = JSON.stringify([week_start, row.site]);
    if (!groups.has(key)) {
      groups.set(key, { week_start, site: row.site, normal: 0, out_of_range: 0 });
    }
    const summary = groups.get(key);
    const value = row.pressure_decay_kpa;
    if (Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= NORMAL_MAX_KPA) {
      summary.normal += 1;
    } else {
      summary.out_of_range += 1;
    }
  }

  return [...groups.values()].sort((left, right) =>
    left.week_start.localeCompare(right.week_start) ||
    left.site.localeCompare(right.site)
  );
}

module.exports = { buildWeeklySummary };
EOF

cat > internal/electrical/importer.go <<'EOF'
package electrical

import (
	"encoding/csv"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"math"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type CircuitReading struct {
	CircuitID      string
	ResistanceMOhm float64
}

// Convert a value from the insulation resistance test into a circuit record.
func ImportCircuitReadings(src io.Reader) ([]CircuitReading, error) {
	reader := csv.NewReader(src)
	header, err := reader.Read()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read header: %w", err)
	}
	if len(header) != 2 || strings.TrimSpace(header[0]) != "circuit_id" || strings.TrimSpace(header[1]) != "resistance_mohm" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected CSV header %q", header)
	}

	var readings []CircuitReading
	line := 1
	for {
		record, err := reader.Read()
		if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			break
		}
		line++
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: %w", line, err)
		}
		if len(record) != 2 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: expected 2 columns, got %d", line, len(record))
		}
		id := strings.TrimSpace(record[0])
		if id == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: circuit_id is empty", line)
		}
		value, err := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(record[1]), 64)
		if err != nil || math.IsNaN(value) || math.IsInf(value, 0) || value < 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: invalid resistance_mohm %q", line, record[1])
		}
		readings = append(readings, CircuitReading{CircuitID: id, ResistanceMOhm: value})
	}

package electrical

import (
	"encoding/csv"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"math"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type CircuitReading struct {
	CircuitID      string
	ResistanceMOhm float64
}

// Convert a value from the insulation resistance reading into a circuit record.
func ImportCircuitReadings(src io.Reader) ([]CircuitReading, error) {
	reader := csv.NewReader(src)
	header, err := reader.Read()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read header: %w", err)
	}
	if len(header) != 2 || strings.TrimSpace(header[0]) != "circuit_id" || strings.TrimSpace(header[1]) != "resistance_mohm" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected CSV header %q", header)
	}

	var readings []CircuitReading
	line := 1
	for {
		record, err := reader.Read()
		if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			break
		}
		line++
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: %w", line, err)
		}
		if len(record) != 2 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: expected 2 columns, got %d", line, len(record))
		}
		id := strings.TrimSpace(record[0])
		if id == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: circuit_id is empty", line)
		}
		value, err := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(record[1]), 64)
		if err != nil || math.IsNaN(value) || math.IsInf(value, 0) || value < 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: invalid resistance_mohm %q", line, record[1])
		}
		readings = append(readings, CircuitReading{CircuitID: id, ResistanceMOhm: value})
	}
	return readings, nil
}

package roadside;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class Importer {
    private Importer() {}

    public record Reading(String driverId, LocalDateTime collectedAt, BigDecimal bacGramsPerLitre) {}

    public static List<Reading> load(Path path) throws IOException {
        List<String> lines = Files.readAllLines(path);
        List<Reading> readings = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i < lines.size(); i++) {
            String line = lines.get(i).trim();
            if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
            String[] fields = line.split(",", -1);
            if (fields.length != 3) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected 3 fields at row " + (i + 1));
            }
            // The breathalyzer test reports the measured BAC in g/L.
            readings.add(new Reading(fields[0], LocalDateTime.parse(fields[1]),
                new BigDecimal(fields[2])));
        }
        return readings;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        for (Reading reading : load(Path.of(args[0]))) {
            System.out.printf("%s %s %s g/L%n", reading.driverId(), reading.collectedAt(),
                reading.bacGramsPerLitre());
        }
    }
}
EOF

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

export type Reading = { collected_at: string; site: string; result_iu_ml: number };
type SiteTotals = { site: string; normal: number; outOfRange: number };

const LOW = 0;
const HIGH = 200;

export function summarizeWeekly(readings: Reading[], weekStart: string): SiteTotals[] {
  const start = new Date(`${weekStart}T00:00:00Z`);
  if (!Number.isFinite(start.getTime())) throw new Error("weekStart must use YYYY-MM-DD");
  const end = new Date(start);
  end.setUTCDate(end.getUTCDate() + 7);
  const totals = new Map<string, SiteTotals>();

  for (const reading of readings) {
    const date = new Date(`${reading.collected_at}T00:00:00Z`);
    if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) || date < start || date >= end) continue;
    if (!Number.isFinite(reading.result_iu_ml)) continue;
    const site = totals.get(reading.site) ?? { site: reading.site, normal: 0, outOfRange: 0 };
    if (reading.result_iu_ml >= LOW && reading.result_iu_ml <= HIGH) site.normal += 1;
    else site.outOfRange += 1;
    totals.set(reading.site, site);
  }

  return [...totals.values()].sort((a, b) => a.site.localeCompare(b.site));
}

const [, ...lines] = readFileSync("data/urgentcare/readings.csv", "utf8").trim().split(/\r?\n/);
const readings = lines.map((line) => {
  const [collected_at, site, rawResult] = line.split(",");
  return { collected_at, site, result_iu_ml: Number(rawResult) };
});
const weekStart = process.argv[2] ?? "2025-03-10";
console.log(JSON.stringify(summarizeWeekly(readings, weekStart), null, 2));
EOF

import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

SOURCE = Path("data/cell_readings.csv")
LOW_MAH = 2800
HIGH_MAH = 3200


def build_summary(path=SOURCE):
    totals = defaultdict(lambda: {"normal": 0, "out_of_range": 0})
    with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        for row in csv.DictReader(stream):
            day = date.fromisoformat(row["measured_at"])
            iso = day.isocalendar()
            key = (f"{iso.year}-W{iso.week:02d}", row["site"])
            capacity = int(row["capacity_mah"])
            bucket = "normal" if LOW_MAH <= capacity <= HIGH_MAH else "out_of_range"
            totals[key][bucket] += 1
    return [
        {"week": week, "site": site, **counts}
        for (week, site), counts in sorted(totals.items())
    ]


def main():
    for row in build_summary():
        print(f'{row["week"]} {row["site"]}: normal={row["normal"]}, out_of_range={row["out_of_range"]}')


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PY

def load_readings(path):
    rows = []
    with Path(path).open(newline='', encoding='utf-8-sig') as source:

            rows.append({
                'patient_id': patient_id,
                'collected_at': collected_at,
                'result': str(value),
            })
    return rows


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Import partner IgE readings')

package electrical

import "sort"

type CircuitReading struct {
	Site           string
	Week           string
	ResistanceMOhm float64
}

type SiteSummary struct {
	Site       string
	Week       string
	Normal     int
	OutOfRange int
}

func WeeklySummary(readings []CircuitReading, low, high float64) []SiteSummary {
	groups := make(map[string]*SiteSummary)
	for _, reading := range readings {
		key := reading.Week + "\x00" + reading.Site
		summary := groups[key]
		if summary == nil {
			summary = &SiteSummary{Site: reading.Site, Week: reading.Week}
			groups[key] = summary
		}
		// Record whether the insulation resistance test is within the specified band.
		if reading.ResistanceMOhm >= low && reading.ResistanceMOhm <= high {
			summary.Normal++
		} else {
			summary.OutOfRange++
		}
	}

	result := make([]SiteSummary, 0, len(groups))
	for _, summary := range groups {
		result = append(result, *summary)
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool {
		if result[i].Week == result[j].Week {
			return result[i].Site < result[j].Site
		}
		return result[i].Week < result[j].Week
	})
	return result
}
EOF

from collections import defaultdict

def summarize(path):
    counts = defaultdict(lambda: {"normal": 0, "out_of_range": 0})

import csv
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

FIELDS = ("sample_id", "chromosome", "position", "ref", "alt",
          "allele_fraction", "depth")

def load_calls(path: str | Path) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    with Path(path).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        reader = csv.DictReader(stream)
        missing = [key for key in FIELDS if key not in (reader.fieldnames or [])]
        if missing:
            raise ValueError(f"missing columns: {', '.join(missing)}")
        records = []
        for line, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
            try:
                position = int(row["position"])
                fraction = float(row["allele_fraction"])
                depth = int(row["depth"])
                if not 0 <= fraction <= 1:
                    raise ValueError("allele_fraction must be between 0 and 1")
                if depth < 0:
                    raise ValueError("depth must be nonnegative")
            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"line {line}: {exc}") from exc
            records.append({
                "sample_id": row["sample_id"],
                "chromosome": row["chromosome"],
                "position": position,
                "ref": row["ref"],
                "alt": row["alt"],
                "allele_fraction": fraction,
                "depth": depth,
            })
        return records

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(json.dumps(load_calls(sys.argv[1]), indent=2))

FIELDS = ("sample_id", "chromosome", "position", "ref", "alt",
          "allele_fraction", "depth")

def load_calls(path: str | Path) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    with Path(path).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        reader = csv.DictReader(stream)
        missing = [key for key in FIELDS if key not in (reader.fieldnames or [])]

                fraction = float(row["allele_fraction"])
                depth = int(row["depth"])
                if not 0 <= fraction <= 1:
                    raise ValueError("allele_fraction must be between 0 and 1")
                if depth < 0:
                    raise ValueError("depth must be nonnegative")
            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"line {line}: {exc}") from exc
            records.append({
                "sample_id": row["sample_id"],
                "chromosome": row["chromosome"],
                "position": position,
                "ref": row["ref"],
                "alt": row["alt"],
                "allele_fraction": fraction,
                "depth": depth,
            })
        return records

if __name__ == "__main__":

import csv
import sys
from collections import defaultdict

export type RadonReading = {
  siteCode: string;
  collectedAt: string;
  radonBqM3: number;
  requiresAction: boolean;
};

const ACTION_LEVEL_BQ_M3 = 200;

/** Whether the radon test result exceeds the action level. */
export function exceedsActionLevel(value: number): boolean {
  return value > ACTION_LEVEL_BQ_M3;
}

export function importRadonCsv(csv: string): RadonReading[] {
  const [header, ...rows] = csv.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
  if (header !== "site_code,collected_at,radon_bq_m3") {
    throw new Error("Unexpected CSV header");
  }
  return rows.map((row, index) => {
    const fields = row.split(",");
    if (fields.length !== 3) throw new Error(`Malformed row ${index + 2}`);
    const [siteCode, collectedAt, rawValue] = fields;
    const radonBqM3 = Number(rawValue);
    if (!siteCode || !collectedAt || !rawValue.trim() || !Number.isFinite(radonBqM3)) {
      throw new Error(`Malformed row ${index + 2}`);
    }
    return { siteCode, collectedAt, radonBqM3, requiresAction: exceedsActionLevel(radonBqM3) };
  });
}
EOF

export type RadonReading = {
  siteCode: string;
  collectedAt: string;
  radonBqM3: number;
  requiresAction: boolean;
};

const ACTION_LEVEL_BQ_M3 = 200;

/** Whether the radon measurement result exceeds the action level. */
export function exceedsActionLevel(value: number): boolean {
  return value > ACTION_LEVEL_BQ_M3;
}

export function importRadonCsv(csv: string): RadonReading[] {
  const [header, ...rows] = csv.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
  if (header !== "site_code,collected_at,radon_bq_m3") {
    throw new Error("Unexpected CSV header");
  }
  return rows.map((row, index) => {
    const fields = row.split(",");
    if (fields.length !== 3) throw new Error(`Malformed row ${index + 2}`);
    const [siteCode, collectedAt, rawValue] = fields;
    const radonBqM3 = Number(rawValue);
    if (!siteCode || !collectedAt || !rawValue.trim() || !Number.isFinite(radonBqM3)) {
      throw new Error(`Malformed row ${index + 2}`);
    }
    return { siteCode, collectedAt, radonBqM3, requiresAction: exceedsActionLevel(radonBqM3) };
  });
}
EOF

    """Return whether a soil test result falls outside the reference range."""

import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

DATA_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("readings.csv")
LOWER_MPA = 350.0
UPPER_MPA = 500.0


def weekly_summary():
    with DATA_PATH.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(source))
    if not rows:
        return "No readings available"

    recent_day = max(date.fromisoformat(row["collected_at"]) for row in rows)
    recent_week = recent_day.isocalendar()[:2]
    counts = defaultdict(lambda: {"normal": 0, "out_of_range": 0})
    for row in rows:
        reading_day = date.fromisoformat(row["collected_at"])
        if reading_day.isocalendar()[:2] != recent_week:
            continue
        value = float(row["yield_mpa"])
        category = "normal" if LOWER_MPA <= value <= UPPER_MPA else "out_of_range"
        counts[row["site"]][category] += 1

    year, week = recent_week
    lines = [f"{year}-W{week:02d}"]
    for site in sorted(counts):
        site_counts = counts[site]
        lines.append(
            f"{site}: normal={site_counts['normal']} "
            f"out_of_range={site_counts['out_of_range']}"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(weekly_summary())

export function parsePartnerCsv(csv: string): PatientRow[] {
  const lines = csv.trimEnd().split(/\r?\n/);
  const headerLine = lines[0];

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
from pathlib import Path

REQUIRED_COLUMNS = ("field_id", "collected_at", "phosphorus_mg_kg")


def load_readings(path: str | Path) -> list[dict[str, str | float]]:
    records = []
    with Path(path).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        reader = csv.DictReader(source)
        if reader.fieldnames is None or not set(REQUIRED_COLUMNS).issubset(reader.fieldnames):
            raise ValueError("CSV is missing required columns")
        for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
            field_id = row.get("field_id") or ""
            collected_at = row.get("collected_at") or ""
            try:
                phosphorus = float(row.get("phosphorus_mg_kg") or "")
            except ValueError as error:
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid phosphorus value on row {row_number}") from error
            if not field_id or not collected_at:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing field ID or collection date on row {row_number}")
            records.append({

                "collected_at": collected_at,

import csv
from pathlib import Path

REQUIRED_COLUMNS = ("field_id", "collected_at", "phosphorus_mg_kg")


def load_readings(path: str | Path) -> list[dict[str, str | float]]:
    records = []
    with Path(path).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        reader = csv.DictReader(source)
        if reader.fieldnames is None or not set(REQUIRED_COLUMNS).issubset(reader.fieldnames):

        for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):

            collected_at = row.get("collected_at") or ""
            try:

                raise ValueError(f"Invalid phosphorus value on row {row_number}") from error
            if not field_id or not collected_at:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing field ID or collection date on row {row_number}")
            records.append({
                "field_id": field_id,
                "collected_at": collected_at,
                "phosphorus_mg_kg": phosphorus,
            })
    return records

"""Utilities for agronomy field records."""

PHOSPHORUS_MIN_MG_KG = 12.0
PHOSPHORUS_MAX_MG_KG = 25.0


def mark_phosphorus_outliers(records):
    """Copy records and add a flag for phosphorus outside the reference range."""
    marked_records = []
    for record in records:
        marked = dict(record)
        value = float(marked["phosphorus_mg_kg"])
        marked["phosphorus_out_of_range"] = not (
            PHOSPHORUS_MIN_MG_KG <= value <= PHOSPHORUS_MAX_MG_KG
        )
        marked_records.append(marked)

import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

SOURCE = Path("data/weekly_steel.csv")
LOWER_MPA = 300
UPPER_MPA = 420


def summarize(rows):
    counts = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
    for row in rows:
        collected = date.fromisoformat(row["collected_at"])
        monday = collected - timedelta(days=collected.weekday())
        value = float(row["yield_mpa"])
        bucket = counts[(monday.isoformat(), row["site"])]
        bucket[0 if LOWER_MPA <= value <= UPPER_MPA else 1] += 1
    return sorted(
        (week, site, values[0], values[1])
        for (week, site), values in counts.items()
    )


def main():
    with SOURCE.open(newline="") as stream:
        rows = csv.DictReader(stream)
        summaries = summarize(rows)
    print("week_start,site,normal,out_of_range")
    for week, site, normal, out_of_range in summaries:
        print(f"{week},{site},{normal},{out_of_range}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

export interface AcuityReading {
  patient_id: string;
  site: string;
  collected_at: string;
  acuity: number;
}

export interface SiteSummary {
  site: string;
  normal: number;
  out_of_range: number;
}

const NORMAL_MIN = 0.8;
const NORMAL_MAX = 1.2;

export function summarizeWeek(
  readings: AcuityReading[],
  startDate: string,
  endDate: string,
): SiteSummary[] {
  const groups = new Map<string, SiteSummary>();
  for (const reading of readings) {
    if (reading.collected_at < startDate || reading.collected_at > endDate) continue;
    let summary = groups.get(reading.site);
    if (!summary) {
      summary = { site: reading.site, normal: 0, out_of_range: 0 };
      groups.set(reading.site, summary);
    }
    if (reading.acuity >= NORMAL_MIN && reading.acuity <= NORMAL_MAX) {
      summary.normal += 1;
    } else {
      summary.out_of_range += 1;
    }
  }
  return Array.from(groups.values()).sort((a, b) => a.site.localeCompare(b.site));
}
EOF

package emissions

import (
	"encoding/csv"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strconv"
	"time"
)

type Reading struct {
	RecordID    string
	CollectedAt string
	COPpm       float64
}

func Read(r io.Reader) ([]Reading, error) {
	reader := csv.NewReader(r)
	header, err := reader.Read()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read header: %w", err)
	}
	columns := make(map[string]int, len(header))
	for i, name := range header {
		columns[name] = i
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"record_id", "collected_at", "co_ppm"} {
		if _, ok := columns[name]; !ok {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing column %q", name)
		}
	}

	rows := make([]Reading, 0)
	for rowNo := 2; ; rowNo++ {
		record, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: %w", rowNo, err)
		}
		date := record[columns["collected_at"]]
		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: invalid date %q", rowNo, date)
		}
		co, err := strconv.ParseFloat(record[columns["co_ppm"]], 64)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d: invalid CO reading: %w", rowNo, err)
		}
		rows = append(rows, Reading{
			RecordID:    record[columns["record_id"]],
			CollectedAt: date,
			COPpm:       co,
		})
	}
	return rows, nil
}
EOF

export type Reading = {
  siteId: string;
  collectedAt: string;
  radonBqM3: number;
};

export type WeeklySummary = {
  siteId: string;
  weekStarting: string;
  normal: number;
  outOfRange: number;
};

const LIMIT_BQ_M3 = 200;

function weekStart(dateText: string): string {
  const date = new Date(`${dateText}T00:00:00Z`);
  const daysSinceMonday = (date.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7;
  date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() - daysSinceMonday);
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export function summarizeWeekly(readings: Reading[]): WeeklySummary[] {
  const rows = new Map<string, WeeklySummary>();

import json
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from csv import DictReader
from datetime import date

LOWER = 3.5
UPPER = 5.1


def summarize(path):
    counts = defaultdict(lambda: {"normal": 0, "out_of_range": 0})
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        for row in DictReader(stream):
            day = date.fromisoformat(row["collected_at"])
            iso = day.isocalendar()
            week = f"{iso.year}-W{iso.week:02d}"
            key = (week, row["site"])
            value = float(row["k_mmol_l"])
            label = "normal" if LOWER <= value <= UPPER else "out_of_range"
            counts[key][label] += 1
    return [
        {"week": week, "site": site, **counts[(week, site)]}
        for week, site in sorted(counts)
    ]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(json.dumps(summarize(sys.argv[1]), indent=2))

package electrical

import (
	"encoding/csv"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type CircuitReading struct {
	CircuitID      string
	ResistanceMOhm float64
	CollectedAt    string
}

func ImportReadings(r io.Reader) ([]CircuitReading, error) {
	reader := csv.NewReader(r)
	header, err := reader.Read()
	if err == io.EOF {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read header: %w", err)
	}

	columns := make(map[string]int, len(header))
	for i, name := range header {
		columns[strings.TrimSpace(name)] = i
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"circuit_id", "resistance_mohm", "collected_at"} {
		if _, ok := columns[name]; !ok {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing column %q", name)
		}
	}

	var readings []CircuitReading
	for rowNum := 2; ; rowNum++ {
		record, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read row %d: %w", rowNum, err)
		}
		circuitID := strings.TrimSpace(record[columns["circuit_id"]])
		if circuitID == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d has an empty circuit ID", rowNum)
		}
		resistance, err := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(record[columns["resistance_mohm"]]), 64)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d has invalid resistance: %w", rowNum, err)
		}
		readings = append(readings, CircuitReading{
			CircuitID:      circuitID,
			ResistanceMOhm: resistance,
			CollectedAt:    strings.TrimSpace(record[columns["collected_at"]]),
		})
	}
	return readings, nil
}
EOF

type CircuitReading struct {
	CircuitID      string
	ResistanceMOhm float64
	CollectedAt    string

func ImportReadings(r io.Reader) ([]CircuitReading, error) {
	reader := csv.NewReader(r)
	header, err := reader.Read()
	if err == io.EOF {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read header: %w", err)
	}

	columns := make(map[string]int, len(header))

		columns[strings.TrimSpace(name)] = i
	}

		if _, ok := columns[name]; !ok {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing column %q", name)
		}
	}

	var readings []CircuitReading
	for rowNum := 2; ; rowNum++ {
		record, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read row %d: %w", rowNum, err)
		}
		circuitID := strings.TrimSpace(record[columns["circuit_id"]])
		if circuitID == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d has an empty circuit ID", rowNum)
		}
		resistance, err := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(record[columns["resistance_mohm"]]), 64)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d has invalid resistance: %w", rowNum, err)
		}
		readings = append(readings, CircuitReading{
			CircuitID:      circuitID,
			ResistanceMOhm: resistance,
			CollectedAt:    strings.TrimSpace(record[columns["collected_at"]]),
		})
	}
	return readings, nil
}

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

export interface AcuityReading {
  patientId: string;
  recordedAt: string;
  acuity: number;
}

const HEADERS = ["patient_id", "recorded_at", "acuity"];

export function parseAcuityCsv(csv: string): AcuityReading[] {
  const [headerLine, ...rows] = csv.split(/\r?\n/).filter((line) => line.trim() !== "");
  if (!headerLine) return [];

  const headers = headerLine.split(",").map((value) => value.trim());
  if (headers.join(",") !== HEADERS.join(",")) {
    throw new Error("CSV columns must be patient_id, recorded_at, acuity");
  }

  return rows.map((line, index) => {
    const [patientId, recordedAt, acuity, ...extra] = line.split(",").map((value) => value.trim());
    if (
      extra.length > 0 ||
      !patientId ||
      /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.exec(recordedAt) === null ||
      /^(?:\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\.\d+)$/.exec(acuity) === null
    ) {
      throw new Error(`Malformed row ${index + 2}: ${line}`);
    }
    return { patientId, recordedAt, acuity: Number(acuity) };
  });
}

const invokedPath = process.argv[1];
if (invokedPath && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(resolve(invokedPath)).href) {
  const csvPath = process.argv[2];
  if (!csvPath) throw new Error("Provide a CSV path");
  const readings = parseAcuityCsv(readFileSync(csvPath, "utf8"));
  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(readings, null, 2)}\n`);
}
EOF

from collections import defaultdict
import csv
import sys


def summarize(path):
    counts = defaultdict(lambda: {"normal": 0, "out_of_range": 0})
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        for row in csv.DictReader(source):
            week = row["week"]
            site = row["site"]
            value = float(row["value_mmol_l"])
            lower = float(row["lower_mmol_l"])
            upper = float(row["upper_mmol_l"])
            # Compare the glucose tolerance test reading with the two-hour care range.
            category = "normal" if lower <= value <= upper else "out_of_range"
            counts[(week, site)][category] += 1
    return counts


if __name__ == "__main__":
    summary = summarize(sys.argv[1])
    print("week,site,normal,out_of_range")
    for week, site in sorted(summary):
        row = summary[(week, site)]
        print(f"{week},{site},{row['normal']},{row['out_of_range']}")

package emissions

import (
	"sort"
	"time"
)

type Reading struct {
	Site       string
	VehicleID  string
	ObservedAt time.Time
	COPercent  float64
}

type SiteSummary struct {
	Site       string
	Normal     int
	OutOfRange int
}

func BuildWeeklySummary(rows []Reading, weekStart time.Time) []SiteSummary {
	weekEnd := weekStart.AddDate(0, 0, 7)
	bySite := make(map[string]*SiteSummary)
	for _, row := range rows {
		if row.ObservedAt.Before(weekStart) || !row.ObservedAt.Before(weekEnd) {
			continue
		}
		summary, ok := bySite[row.Site]
		if !ok {
			summary = &SiteSummary{Site: row.Site}
			bySite[row.Site] = summary
		}
		if row.COPercent < 0 || row.COPercent > 0.50 {
			summary.OutOfRange++
		} else {
			summary.Normal++
		}
	}
	out := make([]SiteSummary, 0, len(bySite))
	for _, summary := range bySite {
		out = append(out, *summary)
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Site < out[j].Site })
	return out
}
EOF

		if row.ObservedAt.Before(weekStart) || !row.ObservedAt.Before(weekEnd) {
			continue
		}
		summary, ok := bySite[row.Site]
		if !ok {
			summary = &SiteSummary{Site: row.Site}
			bySite[row.Site] = summary
		}
		if row.COPercent < 0 || row.COPercent > 0.50 {
			summary.OutOfRange++
		} else {
			summary.Normal++
		}
	}
	out := make([]SiteSummary, 0, len(bySite))
	for _, summary := range bySite {
		out = append(out, *summary)
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Site < out[j].Site })
	return out

import sys
from ipaddress import ip_address, ip_network


def is_allowed(address, subnets):

def record_range(ranges: list[list[int]], start: int, end: int) -> list[list[int]]:

    for left, right in sorted([*ranges, [start, end]]):

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
from pathlib import Path


def load_readings(path: str | Path) -> list[dict[str, str | float]]:
    with Path(path).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return [
            {
                "specimen_id": row["specimen_id"].strip(),
                "yield_strength_mpa": float(row["yield_strength_mpa"]),
            }
            for row in csv.DictReader(handle)
        ]


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("csv_path", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    readings = load_readings(args.csv_path)
    print(f"Imported {len(readings)} steel readings:")
    for reading in readings:
        print(
            f"{reading['specimen_id']} yield strength: "
            f"{reading['yield_strength_mpa']:.1f} MPa"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PY

from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping


def spent_by_category(

) -> dict[str, float]:

<think>The watcher launches a build for every notification. I’ll coalesce closely spaced events and export the small scheduling helper for reuse.</think>
Grouping closely spaced events before starting a build:
```bash
cat > scripts/watch.js <<'EOF'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');

const target = process.argv[2] || 'src';

function createRebuildQueue(rebuild, delay = 25) {
  let timer;
  return () => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timer = undefined;
      rebuild();
    }, delay);
  };
}

if (require.main === module) {
  const scheduleRebuild = createRebuildQueue(() => {
    spawn('npm', ['run', 'build'], { stdio: 'inherit' });
  });
  fs.watch(target, { recursive: true }, (event, filename) => {
    if (!filename) return;
    console.log(`${event}: ${filename}`);
    scheduleRebuild();
  });
}

module.exports = { createRebuildQueue };
EOF
```

import sqlite3


def set_preference(database, name, value):
    with sqlite3.connect(database) as connection:
        connection.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS preferences (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)"
        )
        connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO preferences (name, value) VALUES (?, ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value",
            (name, value),
        )


def get_preference(database, name):
    with sqlite3.connect(database) as connection:

task: Implement a concurrency-safe token-bucket limiter with independent state for each client ID.

messages.content: Use the terminal in /workspace/gateway. Bash, Go, and Git are available. Keep the implementation in the requested package.

Implement a token-bucket limiter keyed by client ID in internal/limit/bucket.go. Each client should receive an independent burst capacity and refill at the configured rate. A small existing CLI in cmd/limit-demo sends three consecutive requests for client maple and prints each result.

<think>A mutex-protected map can keep each client's refill balance independent. I'll expose a small constructor and an Allow method.</think>
Implementing the per-client token bucket:
```bash
cat > internal/limit/bucket.go <<'EOF'
package limit

import (
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type Limiter struct {
	mu              sync.Mutex
	buckets         map[string]*bucket
	capacity        int
	refillPerSecond float64
}

type bucket struct {
	tokens  float64
	updated time.Time
}

func NewLimiter(capacity int, refillPerSecond float64) *Limiter {
	return &Limiter{
		buckets:         make(map[string]*bucket),
		capacity:        capacity,
		refillPerSecond: refillPerSecond,
	}
}

func (l *Limiter) Allow(clientID string) bool {
	l.mu.Lock()
	defer l.mu.Unlock()

	now := time.Now()
	b := l.buckets[clientID]
	if b == nil {
		b = &bucket{tokens: float64(l.capacity), updated: now}
		l.buckets[clientID] = b
	}

	b.tokens += now.Sub(b.updated).Seconds() * l.refillPerSecond
	if b.tokens > float64(l.capacity) {
		b.tokens = float64(l.capacity)
	}
	b.updated = now
	if b.tokens < 1 {
		return false
	}
	b.tokens--
	return true
}
EOF

```bash
cd /workspace/edge && cat > internal/proxy/handler.go <<'EOF'
package proxy

import (
	"io"
	"net/http"
)

type RoundTripper interface {
	RoundTrip(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)
}

type Handler struct {
	upstream RoundTripper
}

func NewHandler(upstream RoundTripper) http.Handler {
	return &Handler{upstream: upstream}
}

func (h *Handler) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(r.Context(), r.Method, r.URL.String(), r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	resp, err := h.upstream.RoundTrip(req)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "upstream unavailable", http.StatusBadGateway)
		return
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	for key, values := range resp.Header {
		for _, value := range values {
			w.Header().Add(key, value)
		}
	}
	w.WriteHeader(resp.StatusCode)
	_, _ = io.Copy(w, resp.Body)
}
EOF

from calendar import monthrange
from datetime import date


def expand_monthly(start: date, count: int) -> list[date]:
    """Return the next count monthly dates on the anchor day."""
    if count < 0:
        raise ValueError("count must be non-negative")

    dates = []
    year, month = start.year, start.month
    while len(dates) < count:
        if start.day <= monthrange(year, month)[1]:
            dates.append(date(year, month, start.day))

            year += 1
    return dates
PY

import sys


def best_trade(prices: list[int]) -> tuple[int, int, int] | None:
    if len(prices) < 2:
        return None

    low_price = prices[0]
    low_day = 0
    best = None
    for sell_day, price in enumerate(prices[1:], start=1):
        gain = price - low_price
        if gain > 0 and (best is None or gain > best[2]):
            best = (low_day, sell_day, gain)
        if price < low_price:
            low_price = price
            low_day = sell_day
    return best


def _main() -> None:
    prices = [int(part) for part in sys.argv[1].split(",")]
    result = best_trade(prices)
    if result is None:
        print("No profitable trade found.")
        return

package cron

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// Next returns the next time matching a minute and hour expression.
func Next(expression string, after time.Time) (time.Time, error) {
	fields := strings.Fields(expression)
	if len(fields) != 2 {
		return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("want minute and hour fields")
	}
	minute, err := parseField(fields[0], 59)
	if err != nil {
		return time.Time{}, err
	}
	hour, err := parseField(fields[1], 23)
	if err != nil {
		return time.Time{}, err
	}
	start := after.Truncate(time.Minute).Add(time.Minute)
	limit := start.Add(8 * 24 * time.Hour)
	for candidate := start; candidate.Before(limit); candidate = candidate.Add(time.Minute) {
		if (minute < 0 || candidate.Minute() == minute) &&
			(hour < 0 || candidate.Hour() == hour) {
			return candidate, nil
		}
	}
	return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("no matching time found")
}

func parseField(field string, maximum int) (int, error) {
	if field == "*" {
		return -1, nil
	}
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(field)
	if err != nil || value < 0 || value > maximum {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid cron field %q", field)
	}
	return value, nil
}
EOF

package emissions

import (
	"encoding/csv"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type Reading struct {
	Plate       string
	COppm       float64
	InspectedAt time.Time
}

func ImportCSV(r io.Reader) ([]Reading, error) {
	cr := csv.NewReader(r)
	header, err := cr.Read()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read header: %w", err)
	}
	if len(header) != 3 || header[0] != "plate" || header[1] != "co_ppm" || header[2] != "inspected_at" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected CSV header: %v", header)
	}

	rows := make([]Reading, 0)
	for line := 2; ; line++ {
		record, err := cr.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read row %d: %w", line, err)
		}
		co, err := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(record[1]), 64)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d CO value: %w", line, err)
		}
		date, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", strings.TrimSpace(record[2]))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("row %d inspection date: %w", line, err)
		}
		rows = append(rows, Reading{
			Plate:       strings.TrimSpace(record[0]),
			COppm:       co,
			InspectedAt: date,
		})
	}
	return rows, nil
}
EOF

def solve(grid: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]] | None:
    board = [row[:] for row in grid]

    def search() -> bool:
        target = None
        options = None
        for r in range(9):
            for c in range(9):
                if board[r][c] == 0:
                    used = set(board[r]) | {board[i][c] for i in range(9)}
                    used |= {board[i][j] for i in range(r // 3 * 3, r // 3 * 3 + 3)
                             for j in range(c // 3 * 3, c // 3 * 3 + 3)}
                    choices = [n for n in range(1, 10) if n not in used]
                    if not choices:
                        return False
                    if options is None or len(choices) < len(options):
                        target, options = (r, c), choices
        if target is None:
            return True
        r, c = target
        for value in options:
            board[r][c] = value
            if search():
                return True
        board[r][c] = 0
        return False

    return board if search() else None
PY

def longest_palindrome(text: str) -> str:
    """Return the longest palindromic substring, favoring the earliest tie."""
    if not text:
        return ""
    start = end = 0
    for center in range(len(text)):
        for left, right in ((center, center), (center, center + 1)):
            while left >= 0 and right < len(text) and text[left] == text[right]:

                left -= 1
                right += 1
    return text[start:end + 1]

pub fn next_generation(grid: &[Vec<bool>]) -> Vec<Vec<bool>> {
    let height = grid.len();
    if height == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let width = grid[0].len();
    if width == 0 {
        return vec![Vec::new(); height];
    }

    (0..height)
        .map(|row| {
            (0..width)
                .map(|col| {
                    let mut neighbors = 0;
                    for dr in [-1isize, 0, 1] {
                        for dc in [-1isize, 0, 1] {
                            if dr == 0 && dc == 0 {
                                continue;
                            }
                            let nr = (row as isize + dr).rem_euclid(height as isize) as usize;
                            let nc = (col as isize + dc).rem_euclid(width as isize) as usize;
                            neighbors += usize::from(grid[nr][nc]);
                        }
                    }
                    neighbors == 3 || (grid[row][col] && neighbors == 2)
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .collect()
}
EOF

messages.content: Work in /workspace/compiler. Use bash and the available C compiler to inspect and edit repository files. Keep changes focused on the requested symbol table.
Implement a hash table with chaining for the compiler symbol table in src/symtab.c. Provide initialization, insertion, lookup, and cleanup functions.

<think>I’ll define a small public interface and implement bucketed chaining with owned key copies.</think>
I’ll add the interface and implement the table with fixed buckets.
```bash
cat > src/symtab.h <<'EOF'
#ifndef SYMTAB_H
#define SYMTAB_H
#define SYMTAB_BUCKETS 7
typedef struct SymtabEntry {
    char *name;
    int value;
    struct SymtabEntry *next;
} SymtabEntry;
typedef struct {
    SymtabEntry *buckets[SYMTAB_BUCKETS];
} Symtab;
void symtab_init(Symtab *table);
int symtab_put(Symtab *table, const char *name, int value);
int symtab_get(const Symtab *table, const char *name, int *value);
void symtab_destroy(Symtab *table);
#endif
EOF
cat > src/symtab.c <<'EOF'
#include "symtab.h"
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static size_t bucket_for(const char *name)
{
    size_t sum = 0;
    const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)name;
    while (*p)
        sum += *p++;
    return sum % SYMTAB_BUCKETS;
}

static char *copy_name(const char *name)
{
    size_t length = strlen(name) + 1;
    char *copy = malloc(length);
    if (copy)
        memcpy(copy, name, length);
    return copy;
}

void symtab_init(Symtab *table)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < SYMTAB_BUCKETS; ++i)
        table->buckets[i] = NULL;
}

int symtab_put(Symtab *table, const char *name, int value)
{
    size_t bucket = bucket_for(name);
    SymtabEntry *entry;
    for (entry = table->buckets[bucket]; entry; entry = entry->next) {
        if (strcmp(entry->name, name) == 0) {
            entry->value = value;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    entry = malloc(sizeof *entry);
    if (!entry)
        return 0;
    entry->name = copy_name(name);
    if (!entry->name) {
        free(entry);
        return 0;
    }
    entry->value = value;
    entry->next = table->buckets[bucket];
    table->buckets[bucket] = entry;
    return 1;
}

int symtab_get(const Symtab *table, const char *name, int *value)
{
    size_t bucket = bucket_for(name);
    const SymtabEntry *entry;
    for (entry = table->buckets[bucket]; entry; entry = entry->next) {
        if (strcmp(entry->name, name) == 0) {
            *value = entry->value;
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void symtab_destroy(Symtab *table)
{
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i < SYMTAB_BUCKETS; ++i) {
        SymtabEntry *entry = table->buckets[i];
        while (entry) {
            SymtabEntry *next = entry->next;
            free(entry->name);
            free(entry);
            entry = next;
        }
        table->buckets[i] = NULL;
    }
}
EOF

package metrics

import (
	"math"
	"sort"
	"time"
)

func Percentiles(durations []time.Duration) (time.Duration, time.Duration) {
	if len(durations) == 0 {
		return 0, 0
	}
	ordered := append([]time.Duration(nil), durations...)
	sort.Slice(ordered, func(i, j int) bool { return ordered[i] < ordered[j] })
	return nearestRank(ordered, 0.50), nearestRank(ordered, 0.95)
}

func nearestRank(ordered []time.Duration, percentile float64) time.Duration {
	index := int(math.Ceil(percentile*float64(len(ordered)))) - 1
	return ordered[index]
}
EOF

func Retry(ctx context.Context, delay time.Duration, operation func(context.Context) error) error {

export interface RadonReading {
  propertyId: string;
  street: string;
  radonPciL: number;
}

export function parsePartnerRadonCsv(csv: string): RadonReading[] {
  const lines = csv.split(/\r?\n/).filter((line, index) => index === 0 || line.trim() !== "");
  if (lines.length === 0 || lines[0].trim() === "") {
    throw new Error("CSV header is required");
  }

  const headers = lines[0].split(",").map((value) => value.trim());
  const required = ["property_id", "street", "radon_pci_l"];
  const positions = required.map((name) => headers.indexOf(name));
  if (positions.some((position) => position < 0)) {
    throw new Error("CSV is missing a required column");
  }

  return lines.slice(1).map((line, index) => {
    const values = line.split(",").map((value) => value.trim());
    const propertyId = values[positions[0]] ?? "";
    const street = values[positions[1]] ?? "";
    const radonText = values[positions[2]] ?? "";
    const radonPciL = Number(radonText);

    if (!propertyId || !street || !radonText || !Number.isFinite(radonPciL) || radonPciL < 0) {
      throw new Error(`Malformed CSV row ${index + 2}`);
    }

    return { propertyId, street, radonPciL };
  });
}
EOF

function parseLinkHeader(header) {
  const result = { next: null, prev: null };

package main

import (

	"path/filepath"
	"sort"

func collectProtoFiles(root string) ([]string, error) {
	var paths []string

}

def dedent_sql(snippet: str) -> str:
    """Remove common leading indentation from an embedded SQL snippet."""
    lines = snippet.splitlines()
    margins = [len(line) - len(line.lstrip()) for line in lines if line.strip()]
    if not margins:

    margin = min(margins)

'use strict';

function importReadings(csv) {
  const [header, ...lines] = csv.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
  const columns = header.split(',').map(column => column.trim());

  return lines
    .filter(line => line.trim() !== '')
    .map(line => {
      const values = line.split(',');
      const record = Object.fromEntries(
        columns.map((column, index) => [column, values[index].trim()])
      );
      const initialPsi = Number(record.initial_psi);
      const finalPsi = Number(record.final_psi);
      const hours = Number(record.hours);

        circuit: record.circuit,
        initial_psi: initialPsi,
        final_psi: finalPsi,
        hours,
        decay_psi_per_hour: Number(((initialPsi - finalPsi) / hours).toFixed(2))
      };
    });
}

module.exports = { importReadings };
EOF

cat > tracks/simplify.py <<'PY'
from math import asin, cos, radians, sin, sqrt


def distance_m(a, b):
    lat1, lon1 = map(radians, a)
    lat2, lon2 = map(radians, b)
    dlat, dlon = lat2 - lat1, lon2 - lon1
    h = sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + cos(lat1) * cos(lat2) * sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    return 12_742_000 * asin(sqrt(h))


def simplify(points):
    points = list(points)
    if not points:
        return []
    kept = [points[0]]
    for point in points[1:]:
        if distance_m(kept[-1], point) >= 5.0:
            kept.append(point)
    return kept

import ast


def _calculate(node):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and type(node.value) in (int, float):
        return node.value
    if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.op, (ast.UAdd, ast.USub)):
        value = _calculate(node.operand)
        return value if isinstance(node.op, ast.UAdd) else -value
    if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
        left, right = _calculate(node.left), _calculate(node.right)
        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add):
            return left + right
        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub):
            return left - right
        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult):
            return left * right
        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Div):
            return left / right
    raise ValueError("unsupported expression")


def calculate(source):
    return _calculate(ast.parse(source, mode="eval").body)

public final class Scheduler {

package electrical

import "sort"

type Reading struct {
	Site    string
	Circuit string
	Megohms float64
}

type SiteSummary struct {
	Site       string
	Normal     int
	OutOfRange int
}

func WeeklySummary(readings []Reading) []SiteSummary {
	bySite := make(map[string]*SiteSummary)
	for _, reading := range readings {
		summary := bySite[reading.Site]
		if summary == nil {
			summary = &SiteSummary{Site: reading.Site}
			bySite[reading.Site] = summary
		}
		if reading.Megohms >= 0.2 && reading.Megohms <= 5.0 {
			summary.Normal++
		} else {
			summary.OutOfRange++
		}
	}
	result := make([]SiteSummary, 0, len(bySite))
	for _, summary := range bySite {
		result = append(result, *summary)
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].Site < result[j].Site })
	return result
}

Adding host and port parsing without changing the response.
```bash
cat > scripts/serve.js <<'EOF'
const http = require("node:http");

function parseOptions(argv) {
  const options = { host: "127.0.0.1", port: 3000 };
  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i += 1) {
    const arg = argv[i];
    if (arg === "--host") options.host = argv[++i];
    else if (arg.startsWith("--host=")) options.host = arg.slice(7);
    else if (arg === "--port") options.port = Number(argv[++i]);
    else if (arg.startsWith("--port=")) options.port = Number(arg.slice(7));
  }
  return options;
}

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  res.end("development server ready\n");
});

if (require.main === module) {
  const { host, port } = parseOptions(process.argv.slice(2));
  server.listen(port, host, () => {
    console.log(`Listening on http://${host}:${port}`);
  });
}

module.exports = { parseOptions };
EOF

const http = require("node:http");

function parseOptions(argv) {
  const options = { host: "127.0.0.1", port: 3000 };
  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i += 1) {
    const arg = argv[i];
    if (arg === "--host") options.host = argv[++i];
    else if (arg.startsWith("--host=")) options.host = arg.slice(7);
    else if (arg === "--port") options.port = Number(argv[++i]);
    else if (arg.startsWith("--port=")) options.port = Number(arg.slice(7));
  }
  return options;
}

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  res.end("development server ready\n");
});

if (require.main === module) {
  const { host, port } = parseOptions(process.argv.slice(2));
  server.listen(port, host, () => {
    console.log(`Listening on http://${host}:${port}`);
  });
}

module.exports = { parseOptions };
EOF

class Order(TypedDict):

<think>The insertion sort keeps equal timestamps in place while moving records into ascending timestamp order.</think>
I added the record type and ordering function:
```bash
cat > src/records.h <<'EOF'
#ifndef RECORDS_H
#define RECORDS_H
#include <stddef.h>
typedef struct {
    long timestamp;
    unsigned sensor_id;
} Record;
void order_records(Record *records, size_t count);
#endif
EOF
cat > src/records.c <<'EOF'
#include "records.h"

void order_records(Record *records, size_t count) {
    for (size_t i = 1; i < count; ++i) {
        Record current = records[i];
        size_t j = i;
        while (j > 0 && records[j - 1].timestamp > current.timestamp) {
            records[j] = records[j - 1];
            --j;
        }
        records[j] = current;

Implement `cmd/bigfiles/main.go` as a CLI that prints the ten largest regular files beneath a directory, ordered by size. Print each size and path, and report a useful error if the directory cannot be read.

<think>I’ll add a recursive file walk, sort entries by descending size, and print up to ten results.</think>
Writing the command:
```bash
mkdir -p cmd/bigfiles examples && cat > cmd/bigfiles/main.go <<'EOF'
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
)

type fileEntry struct {
	path string
	size int64
}

func largestFiles(root string, limit int) ([]fileEntry, error) {
	var files []fileEntry
	err := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
		if walkErr != nil {
			return walkErr
		}
		if d.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		info, err := d.Info()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			files = append(files, fileEntry{path: path, size: info.Size()})
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sort.Slice(files, func(i, j int) bool {
		if files[i].size == files[j].size {
			return files[i].path < files[j].path
		}
		return files[i].size > files[j].size
	})
	if limit >= 0 && len(files) > limit {
		files = files[:limit]
	}
	return files, nil
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: bigfiles DIRECTORY")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	files, err := largestFiles(os.Args[1], 10)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	for _, file := range files {
		fmt.Printf("%d\t%s\n", file.size, file.path)
	}
}
EOF

  transactions: Transaction[],
): Record<string, number> {

"""Text helpers for command-line help output."""

import textwrap


def format_help(text: str) -> str:
    """Wrap each nonblank help line to 72 columns."""
    return "\n".join(
        textwrap.fill(line, width=72) if line else ""
        for line in text.splitlines()
    )
